title: ZYpsilon · Projection lab
description:
Free interactive 3D laboratory for descriptive geometry. It shows how orthogonal projections (Monge), axonometry, perspective, shadows and sections with a cutting plane are built, in the browser and with nothing to install. Version 1.2 added the Intersection Lab, a teaching mode for the interpenetration of two solids by the cutting-plane method.

Interface in English, Italian and Chinese. Licence: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 — free for study, teaching and research; commercial use requires a separate written licence.
